name: Weapon & Armor Enchanting
description: Core item enhancement using Enchant Weapon / Enchant Armor scrolls. Increases basic P. Atk, M. Atk, P. Def, and unlocks special glow/stat milestones.

facts.break_mechanic: In Classic/Main, failing above safe level crystallizes the item into Gemstones and Crystals. In Essence, failing regular scrolls destroys the item; Blessed/Stable scrolls preserve item or reset to safe value.

notes: In Aden Arena Season 1, safe enchant is +3 weapons / +4 full armor. Broken gear produces D/C Gemstones and Crystals.

name: Soul Crystal Insertion & Compounding
description: Insertion of Aden and Hardin soul crystals into weapon/armor slots and combining duplicate crystals to elevate crystal rank.

facts.compounding_success_rule: Combine 2 identical crystals of Level X; success produces Level X+1; failure resets to safety checkpoint (Lv 1, Lv 6, Lv 11, Lv 16)
facts.socket_slots: 2 slots available on weapons, 1-2 on armor

notes: Provides deterministic safety tiers every 5 levels.

name: Skill Enchanting Mechanics
description: System to enchant 3rd class active and passive skills up to +3 using EXP, Adena, and Spellbook absorption experience.

facts.exp_absorption: Players can feed SP Pouches (3M adena) or Spellbooks to satisfy modification EXP requirements

name: Jewel Compounding
description: Synthesizing identical brooch jewels to advance from Level 1 up to Level 8.

facts.compounding_rule: Combine Jewel A (Lv X) + Jewel A (Lv X) with Adena fee
facts.failure_result: One jewel is preserved at Lv X, the other is destroyed
facts.stat_multipliers: Lv 1 = +5% shot dmg -> Lv 8 = +25% shot dmg + 15% skill power + passive damage reflection

name: Doll Compounding
description: Compounding duplicate boss dolls of the same grade to synthesize higher tier dolls.

facts.success_rate: 10% base chance for single doll compounding
facts.guaranteed_compounding: Accumulates failure points until a 100% pity threshold is achieved

notes: Pity system eliminates complete RNG dead-ends.
